ShortTitle: Insecure HTTP access from Internet to Web Application
Description: Uncontrolled HTTP flow from Internet to Web Application can lead to sensitive data exposure.
Possible Mitigation(s): Encrypt data in transit and at rest, avoid sending sensitive information in clear text between Internet and Web Application, and minimise the amount of data exposed.

ShortTitle: Direct Internet access to Web Application without application-layer protection
Description: Uncontrolled HTTPS flow from Internet to Web Application can lead to initial access from untrusted networks.
Possible Mitigation(s): Place secure gateways (WAF, VPN, reverse proxy) in front of Web Application and restrict inbound HTTPS traffic from the Internet to authenticated, encrypted and strictly necessary endpoints.

ShortTitle: Direct Internet access to App Service without application-layer protection
